verdict.rationale: Auth0 offers event-triggered automation through Actions, which are versioned Node.js functions that run inside login and identity flows. Log streaming exports tenant logs continuously in the background, and the CLI is documented to 'automate tasks.' These are trigger-bound identity hooks and scriptable tooling, not a general facility for autonomous background automations; the AI features (CIBA, Token Vault) secure other people's background agents rather than run them. Missing for 10: scheduled or cron-style jobs, general-purpose autonomous workflows outside identity flows, agent-driven background runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
